name: C C Land Holdings Limited
summary: C C Land Holdings Limited, established in 1998 and headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company developing and investing in property in the United Kingdom, Hong Kong and mainland China. Its two divisions are property development and investment, and treasury investment. It also invests in securities and notes receivable and offers financial services. Until January 2007 it was named Qualipak International Holdings Limited.
